method: Workbook-only semantic inference from feature titles, groups, dates and notes. All edges are hypotheses, not Jira-recorded links.
confidenceMeaning: High means strong semantic relationship between the named deliverables, not verified scheduling precedence. Medium means an architecture or acceptance-scope assumption needs validation.
dateRules: Compare predecessor Feature Done due with successor P-D due as an overlap signal, never an automatic blocker.
Compare predecessor Feature Done due with successor Feature Done due to identify conditional final-readiness risks.
Do not infer start dates or actual completion from due dates.
A status of P-D is not assumed to mean final Feature Done.
Unknown and missing dates remain unknown.
